title: Three balloons
done: Red, yellow and blue balloons, floating up to the sky.

steps.say: Lay it flat on the table. Top row, left to right: a red corner triangle in the bottom right, a red corner triangle in the bottom left, a gap, a yellow corner triangle in the bottom right, a yellow corner triangle in the bottom left, a gap, a blue corner triangle in the bottom right, a blue corner triangle in the bottom left.
Next row down, left to right: 2 red squares, a gap, 2 yellow squares, a gap, 2 blue squares.

Next row down, left to right: a red corner triangle in the top right, a red corner triangle in the top left, a gap, a yellow corner triangle in the top right, a yellow corner triangle in the top left, a gap, a blue corner triangle in the top right, a blue corner triangle in the top left.
Next row down, left to right: a gap, an orange square, 2 gaps, an orange square, a gap, an orange square.
Next row down, left to right: 2 gaps, 4 orange squares.
